title: cerastium szowitsii var. glabratum
intro: Cerastium szowitsii var. glabratum, commonly known as Snow-in-summer, is a flowering plant species within the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in traditional medicine to treat wounds and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium szowitsii var. glabratum include its ability to act as a vulnerary, helping to heal wounds and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
